title: Compliance schedules retire or wipe with a very short grace

minDestructiveGraceDays.text: Minimum days before a retire or wipe action may run

report.title: {Items.Count} Windows compliance {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy retires or wipes', 'policies retire or wipe')} sooner than {params.minDestructiveGraceDays} days

messages.businessImpact: A device that fails a check can be retired or wiped before the user or the service desk has time to recover it, which turns a compliance miss into lost data or a rebuild.
remediation: Lengthen the grace on retire and wipe, and keep Mark device noncompliant as the earlier action Conditional Access can use.
messages.cannotSee: Whether a wipe is selective or full is not distinguished. Notification-only policies do not raise. Settings Catalog compliance is unread.
